annotations.title: Create a planned Style Sheet character change

description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Spends the quoted credits and queues the character-region change from plan_style_sheet_character_edit. It keeps the same project and patches only the character slot into the current Style Sheet. Safe to retry with the same planId. The previous approval is cleared; poll get_style_sheet_character_edit_status, show the revised image to the user, then approve_design_sheet only after the user explicitly approves it.
name: create_style_sheet_character_edit
